# physical-router-test-automation

> Multi-tier test framework for [tollgate-module-basic-go](https://github.com/OpenTollGate/tollgate-module-basic-go) running against physical OpenWrt routers. Combines Playwright LuCI UI tests, pytest…

Project orientation for LLMs (see https://llmstxt.org/). Cross-link: AGENTS.md (workflow rules), HANDOVER.md (session state).

## Stack

Languages/build: npm/TS-JS, Make.

- `.md`: 27 files
- `.sh`: 26 files
- `.mjs`: 25 files
- `.yaml`: 20 files
- `.json`: 5 files
